criteria.requirement: At full acceptance, native production-path evidence must cover all four Production SV check groups through the production interaction state and input router: every required legal, illegal, random, and DNA choice over server-provided lists; stable highlighting, keyboard and mouse navigation, confirmation, quitting, and absence of partial-result sends; both compile orders, unavailable trait/body skips, dedicated IDDC/PvP paths, post-mode PvP Maia return, every required Backspace owner transition, and completed-packet suppression; network/focus/resize interleaving plus disconnect and stale-generation send suppression; and every reachable Guide entry with the exact placeholder, return to the same caller with unchanged selection and draft, and no Guide-state or network operation. Evidence must be produced and verified at the exact accepted contract digest and HEAD.

source.quote:
## Production SV проверки

1. Каждый legal/illegal/random choice и server-provided list, highlighted stable
   identity, keyboard/mouse navigation, confirm и quit.
2. Оба compile orders, skipped unavailable trait/body, dedicated IDDC/PvP и
   post-mode PvP Maia return; Backspace не отправляет completed packet.
3. Interleaved network/focus/resize не меняет owner или selection; disconnect и
   stale generation запрещают дальнейший send.
4. Каждый достижимый Guide entry показывает ровно `The guide is in development`
   и возвращает тот же birth caller без Guide state/network operation.

## Definition of Done

Все ветви идут через production interaction state и input router; fixed-response
wizard не принимается.

criteria.deferralReason: The contract completion scope is implementation. This native runtime evidence is collected during full acceptance after the implementation is available; the deferral is caused by the acceptance phase boundary, not by the absence of a repository runner.
criteria.owner: SV-B-023 implementation assignee produces the evidence; the Sandcastle controller full-acceptance verifier validates it

criteria.requirement: 1. Minimize changes to the existing client and shared files, and place implementation and adaptation in SV wherever possible.

source.quote: существующего клиента и общих файлов. Реализацию и адаптацию по возможности

criteria.requirement: 2. Intentional duplication is acceptable when it preserves SV isolation and avoids importing a large dependency set.

source.quote: размещать в SV. Дублирование реализации допустимо, если оно позволяет сохранить

criteria.requirement: 3. Extract shared code only when the current task requires it, not solely to eliminate duplication.

source.quote: это нужно для текущей задачи, а не только ради устранения дублирования.

criteria.requirement: 4. Preserve the protocol and gameplay semantics of the behavior baseline during the port.

source.quote: При переносе сохранять протокольную и игровую семантику behavior baseline.

criteria.requirement: 5. Tests exercise the production SV path; no separate test-only implementation of behavior is used.

source.quote:
Тесты должны вызывать production-путь SV; локальная SV-реализация допустима,
отдельная реализация поведения только для тестов — нет.

criteria.requirement: 6. Any improvement opportunities discovered in legacy code, shared modules, or SV organization are recorded in docs/sv-improvements.md separately from the current feature implementation.

source.quote: записывать в [список улучшений](docs/sv-improvements.md), отдельно от реализации

criteria.requirement: 7. Each recorded improvement identifies the problem, affected code, proposal, status, and required checks.

source.quote: предложение, статус и необходимые проверки. Запись сама по себе не включает

criteria.requirement: 8. Recording an improvement does not add it to the current task, and intentional duplication used for isolation is not treated by itself as a defect or a mandatory future merge.

source.quote: улучшение в текущую задачу. Намеренное дублирование ради изоляции не является

criteria.requirement: 9. Apply this SV isolation policy in preference to older project-document wording that requires a shared SV and legacy implementation.

source.quote: Это правило имеет приоритет над прежними формулировками проектных документов,

criteria.requirement: 10. When creating, triaging, or reviewing tasks, use local Markdown with Wayfinder items in .scratch/ and SV implementation tickets in docs/tasks/, following the referenced path and status rules.

source.quote: При создании, triage и review задач используйте локальный Markdown: Wayfinder в `.scratch/`, SV implementation tickets в `docs/tasks/`. Правила путей и статусов — в [docs/agents/issue-tracker.md](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md).

criteria.requirement: 11. During triage, use the five standard roles and a separate Labels field, following the referenced role mapping.

source.quote: При triage используйте пять стандартных ролей и отдельное поле `Labels:`. Соответствие ролей — в [docs/agents/triage-labels.md](docs/agents/triage-labels.md).

criteria.requirement: 12. Before working with domain terminology or architecture, read the root CONTEXT.md and task-relevant ADRs, and follow the referenced single-context layout rules.

source.quote: Перед работой с доменными терминами или архитектурой читайте корневой `CONTEXT.md` и относящиеся к задаче ADR. Правила single-context layout — в [docs/agents/domain.md](docs/agents/domain.md).

checks.description: Controller-owned review and fresh final-audit gate at the exact contract digest and HEAD

At full acceptance, the SV-B-023 implementation assignee conducts controller-observed native SV sessions built from the exact accepted contract digest and HEAD through the production interaction state and input router. The evidence bundle must provide a scenario-indexed pass/fail ledger, captured owner/selection/draft transitions, and outbound-send and Guide-operation traces for every case in P1-AC30, including both compile orders. The Sandcastle controller full-acceptance verifier audits every scenario and artifact at that same digest and HEAD; any missing or failing scenario, fixed-response wizard path, test-only behavior implementation, changed caller/selection/draft, or prohibited send or Guide operation fails the check.

verification.summary: The proposal accurately represents all authoritative obligations, production-path checks, scope boundaries, and deferred ownership. The deferred native runtime evidence has explicit producer and verifier owners, requires exact contract-digest and HEAD alignment, and does not rely on the existing controller checks as substitute evidence.
